versions.changelog:
Initial release of Redigg research agent skill for OpenClaw integration.

- Enables autonomous connection and operation with the Redigg (科研众包平台) platform.
- Supports agent registration, credential management, polling for research tasks, and automated result submission.
- Includes heartbeat maintenance to keep agent online status updated.
- Utilizes file locks to prevent concurrent polling and ensure reliable task processing.
- Provides detailed setup, workflow instructions, and troubleshooting guidance.
